cc:Work.dc:title: Box - Crate
cc:Work.dc:description:
Crate with handles. Can be made stackable. Can produce additional mask to put patterns onto crate walls
Pattern mask can be used in your editor to cut out from some pattern section that will be added to walls.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes Crate --x 180 --y 120 --h 90 --MakeStackable 0 --HandleWidth 80 --HandleHeight 20 --HandleRadius 6 --HandleOffset 15 --thickness 4 --burn 0.15 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes Crate --x --y --h --MakeStackable --HandleWidth --HandleHeight --HandleRadius --HandleOffset --thickness --burn --reference --labels
